]> &project; Changelog
This release contains all of the changes up to and including those in Apache Tomcat 11.0.27 plus the additional changes listed below. (markt) The minimum Java version has been updated to Java 21. (markt) Treat a filter as not supporting asynchronous processing unless async supported is explicitly set to "true". Previously, a filter registered via ServletContext.addFilter() that did not call setAsyncSupported(true) was incorrectly treated as async supported, and descriptor values such as "yes" were treated as true for some uses and false for others. (remm) Lower the log level to debug when OpenSSL initialization fails in OpenSSLLifecycleListener to avoid stack traces when libssl.so is not present and to align the behavior of the isAvailable() check with the AprLifecycleListener and gracefully fail when natives are not present. (csutherl) Prevent duplicate log messages when clustering JARs are not present on startup. (csutherl) Add support for configuring TLS pre-shared keys under an SSLHostConfig. (markt) Add TLS pre-shared key support to the OpenSSL FFM implementation. (markt) Add TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 pre-shared key support to Apache Tribes. (markt) Add the Jakarta EE 12 XML schemas. (markt) Add support for the new Servlet API method HttpServletResponse.sendEarlyHints(). (markt) Remove JDBCAccessLogValve which provides limited functionality compared to what is expected from an AccessLog and was not implemented in a scalable way. (remm) Added support for limiting the number of parameters in HTTP requests through the new ParameterLimitValve. The valve allows configurable URL-specific limits on the number of parameters. (dsoumis) Remove the useAcceptRanges initialisation parameter for the default servlet. It is now effectively hard coded to true. (markt) Change the default for the encodedSolidusHandling attribute of Context from decode to reject. (markt) When searching the web application class loader for a resource or resources by name, align the behaviour with the JRE class loaders and always return null if the provided name starts with /. (markt) Update StoreRegistry to dynamically load optional clustering classes rather than statically referencing them. This matches the pattern used in Catalina.addClusterRuleSet() and prevents NoClassDefFoundError when StoreConfigLifecycleListener is configured but clustering classes are not available. (csutherl) Update the default value for the allowPostAsGet initialisation parameter of the Default servlet from true to false. This means a direct request (i.e. not a forward or an include) for a static resource using the POST method will be rejected by default. (markt) Calls to HttpServletRequest.getContextPath() now return the canonical context path for the web application rather than the component of the request URI presented by the user agent that maps to the context path. (markt) Change the default value of the archiveIndexStrategy attribute of the Resources element from simple to bloom to improve web application class loading performance. (markt) Remove regular expression support for the configuration of internal and trusted proxies for the RemoteIpFilter and RemoteIpValve. (markt) Remove the RemoteAddrFilter and RemoteAddrValve. (markt) Change the default for the digestInRfc3112Order attribute of MessageDigestCredentialHandler from false to true. (markt) Add constants to HttpServletResponse for the HTTP status codes defined in RFC 6585. (markt) Enhance version.sh and version.bat to display APR, Tomcat Native, and OpenSSL version information (both APR and FFM implementations), along with version compatibility warnings and third-party library version information. (csutherl) Reject BASIC authorization with no password, to comply with RFC 7617 strictly. (remm) Reject BASIC authorization with empty user names as required by RFC 7613. (markt) Add support for the HTTP QUERY method as defined in RFC 10008. Based on pull request 1026 by Mario Daniel Ruiz Saavedra. (markt) Remove the Context attribute urlPatternsProvidedInDecodedForm and all supporting code. The attribute is now effectively hard-coded to true for all web applications which is a change from the default of false in Tomcat 11 and earlier. The default implementation of Context.addServletMapping(String,String,boolean) has been removed so classes that implement the Context interface must implement this method. (markt) Use the resolved roleBase value when computing the distinguished name of a group found during a nested role search in JNDIRealm, so that groups nested more than one level deep are found when roleBase uses pattern replacements. (remm) Track the StartTlsResponse used by JNDIRealm per connection rather than in a single realm-wide field, so that closing one pooled connection when useStartTls is enabled no longer terminates the TLS session of another, still active pooled connection. (remm) Select the primary or alternate directory server URL for each JNDIRealm connection attempt individually rather than via a realm-wide mutable flag that concurrent pooled connections raced on, which could transiently cause a connection to use the wrong URL. Note that this removes the connectionAttempt protected field and changes the signature of the protected getDirectoryContextEnvironment() method. (remm) Stop pre-digesting the HTTP DIGEST client digest in JAASCallbackHandler. The pre-digest, a leftover from the pre-CredentialHandler design, could never match the deterministic server digest and so made DIGEST authentication via JAASRealm always fail whenever the realm's credential handler algorithm matched the digest algorithm. The client digest is now passed to the LoginModule unchanged, consistent with the non-JAAS realms. (remm) Give the SSI conditional expression operators && and || distinct precedences, && binding more tightly than ||, consistent with the convention used by the C-like languages and by Apache HTTP Server expressions. Previously, mixed chains were evaluated strictly left to right, so $a || $b && $c was evaluated as ($a || $b) && $c rather than the expected $a || ($b && $c). Note that this changes the evaluation of existing documents using unparenthesized mixed && and || chains. (remm) Fix the built-in SSI variables DATE_GMT, DATE_LOCAL and LAST_MODIFIED always resolving to null and rendering as (none). The mediator stored and looked them up as external variables using names starting with its own fully qualified class name, which the servlet resolver rejects since those names fall under the reserved org.apache.catalina. prefix. Hold the built-in variables in the mediator itself and resolve them there, as they are per-document values that do not need to be stored in the external resolver. (remm) Fix multiple data races in annotation scanning when the parallelAnnotationScanning attribute of the StandardContext is enabled. Classes matched for a ServletContainerInitializer were collected into non-thread-safe sets, which could silently lose matches. A scanner thread could also cache an incomplete set of initializers for a class when another thread had not finished adding that class' super class or interfaces to the shared class cache, and the lazily computed set was not safely published between threads. Matched classes could therefore be missing from the set passed to ServletContainerInitializer.onStartup(), misconfiguring the application at runtime. (remm) When automatic migration of a legacy Java EE web application from the legacyAppBase to the appBase failed after the previous version of the application had been moved aside, the previous application was left in a temporary location from which it was neither restored nor cleaned up, making it effectively lost. The previous application is now restored to the deployment location when the migrated application cannot be placed, and is retained with a warning in the temporary location only in the rare cases where restoring it is not possible. (remm) Fix the ManagerSF store configuration factory always treating a started StandardManager as non-default, since the manager propagates its (possibly null) node identifier to its session ID generator when it starts, which the default check compared against an empty string. This caused a redundant Manager element with a nested SessionIdGenerator to be written for every context using the default manager configuration when the running configuration was stored. The default check was strengthened to require the exact manager and session ID generator classes and to test throwOnFailure, so the now reachable skip path cannot silently drop a customised configuration. (remm) Correctly handle error reports that cannot be proxied by ProxyErrorReportValve. Previously, a relative location or an unreachable, non-HTTP or failing proxy target resulted in an empty response with only the error status set. The valve now falls back to the error report of the default ErrorReportValve in these cases, no longer applies proxy target metadata to the response before the target response has been received, restricts proxying to absolute HTTP and HTTPS URLs and applies connect and read timeouts to the connection to the proxy target. (remm) Make the selection of the effective parameter limits by ParameterLimitValve deterministic when several configured URL patterns match a request. Previously, the first matching pattern was encountered in hash map iteration order, which is arbitrary for java.util.regex.Pattern keys and could change between JVM restarts. The limits are now stored in configuration order and the first matching pattern in configuration order is applied. (remm) When the Servlet asynchronous processing mechanism is used, SemaphoreValve no longer attempts to acquire a second permit when the request is dispatched back to the container. A saturated semaphore previously rejected such a dispatch with a 503 response or an IllegalStateException. The permit obtained when asynchronous processing starts is now released when that asynchronous processing completes or fails. (remm) Correct the values of the TIME_MON and TIME_WDAY server variables in the rewrite valve, which exposed the raw java.util.Calendar fields (month 0-11, day of week 1-7 with Sunday first) instead of the documented mod_rewrite values (month 1-12, day of week 0-6 with Sunday being 0). (remm) Stop resolving the REMOTE_IDENT server variable of the rewrite valve to the authenticated user name. REMOTE_IDENT is the RFC 931 ident protocol user name, which Tomcat does not support. It now resolves to undefined, expanding to an empty string, instead of silently turning ident-based rules into authentication checks. (remm) Refactor the default Servlet Accept-Encoding handling to use the common HTTP header parser for processing these headers. (markt) Connector compression will now enable gzip compression with a request header of the form Accept-Encoding: *. (markt) Remove JAASRealm. (schultz) Correct the DER INTEGER encoding produced by Asn1Writer.writeInteger() for multi-byte values and add the leading zero byte required by DER for positive values whose most significant bit is set. The length calculation loops in writeInteger() and writeTag() were also corrected to terminate, since the Java shift distance is evaluated modulo 32. (remm) Correct the selection of multi-release JAR entries by the jar:file: and file: based JAR implementation used when scanning. The entry selected for a class present with multiple versions depended on the order of the entries in the JAR, so an older version, or a version intended for a later runtime, could be scanned instead of the version the runtime would use. The highest applicable version is now selected, independently of the entry order, matching the behaviour of the stream based JAR implementation. (remm) Correct the accounting of the count of submitted tasks that ThreadPoolExecutor maintains for TaskQueue. The count was not always adjusted when a submitted task could no longer complete, such as when a rejected execution handler did not throw, or when a queued task was removed. A drifted value caused thread pools with idle threads to create unnecessary threads. (remm) Change the default value of the cookiesWithoutEquals attribute of the Rfc6265CookieProcessor from name to ignore. (markt) Remove default password value (was changeit) for the certificateKeystorePassword attribute of a certificate. (remm) Remove NIO2 connector. (remm) Add specific certificate selection code for TLS 1.3 supporting post quantum cryptography. Certificates defined with type MLDSA will be selected depending on the TLS client hello. (remm) Add groups attribute on SSLHostConfig allowing to restrict which groups can be enabled on the SSL engine. (remm) Remove support for HTTP 0.9. (markt) 70236: Fix a stalled TLS handshake with the OpenSSL based implementations of SSLEngine when the first flight of handshake messages sent by the server is too large to fit in the buffer used by the BIO pair. Patch submitted by Lukas Hellebrandt. (remm) Ensure the Tomcat Native based OpenSSL SSLContext does not drop TLS 1.3 when rebuilding the list of enabled protocols during initialization. (dsoumis) Keep the asynchronous timeout in place until the timeout event has been processed, rather than clearing it when the event is dispatched. A dispatched event may be discarded without being processed, for example when no container thread is available to process it, which previously left the asynchronous request running without any timeout. (remm) Restore the fall-back to the raw method token when the request method, parsed from bytes, is not one of the methods known to Tomcat. This fall-back was lost when the internal representation of the method changed from MessageBytes to String, causing unknown methods to be reported as null to the application, which typically resulted in a 500 response with a null pointer exception instead of the expected 501 response. (remm) Stop reporting available bytes once a request body that was buffered to allow a TLS client authentication renegotiation has been read in full. Reporting the buffered length, or data belonging to a pipelined next request, as available after the end of the stream was reached violated the ServletInputStream contract and could keep an application loop that polls available() running. (remm) Report a clean end of input on an upgraded connection as end of stream, with blocking and non-blocking reads returning -1 and the non-blocking ReadListener receiving onAllDataRead(), rather than as an error with an EOFException. Also ensure that no further ReadListener call-backs occur once an error has been reported to the listener, or once the end of the data has been reported. (remm) Report an error to the WriteListener of an upgraded connection at most once and stop triggering further call-backs once an error has been reported. A single failure to flush the output was previously reported to the listener multiple times. (remm) When releasing the HTTP/2 connection back log, cap the allocation to each stream at the connection window capacity that remains to be distributed, decrement that capacity by every allocation made and stop distributing once it is exhausted. Previously, when the capacity was exhausted by incremental streams, allocations could exceed the capacity the client had made available, since every incremental stream received a share rounded up to at least one byte and non-incremental streams at the same urgency level received a share computed using a denominator that only counted incremental streams. The connection could then send more data than the client's flow control window allowed, which a compliant client must treat as a connection error of type FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR. Streams that are left without an allocation remain in the back log and are considered again when the next window increment arrives. (remm) Permit the WINDOW_UPDATE and RST_STREAM frames that may legitimately be in flight when an HTTP/2 stream is closed by the receipt of an end of stream frame, rather than treating them as a connection error of type STREAM_CLOSED that closes the entire connection. These frames are already permitted when the stream is closed in the other direction. (remm) The JSON parser now rejects input with a nesting depth greater than 1000 with a ParseException. Previously, deeply nested input caused a StackOverflowError since the parser recursed once per nesting level with no limit. RFC 8259 allows implementations to set a limit on the maximum depth of nesting. (remm) In the OpenSSL cipher configuration parser, treat an AND expression (+) that contains an unknown term as matching no ciphers and log a warning, rather than silently ignoring the unknown term and using only the known terms. This matches OpenSSL behavior, where such an expression results in no cipher match. (remm) In the OpenSSL cipher name conversion, ignore the unimplemented SSLv2 ciphers so that names shared with a modern cipher, for example RC4-MD5, resolve to the JSSE name of the modern cipher rather than returning null, and so that names matching only an SSLv2 cipher no longer resolve to a non-standard name. Ambiguous and unknown names still resolve to null; the OpenSSL engine implementations now filter such unmapped names rather than adding null to the lists of cipher suites they expose. (remm) Correct the computation of the authentication method passed to a custom X509TrustManager by the FFM based OpenSSL implementation. The key exchange and authentication NIDs of the negotiated cipher were compared against legacy OpenSSL flag values rather than the actual NID constants, so the trust manager received UNKNOWN as the authentication type for almost every cipher suite. The computation now matches the one performed by the JNI based implementation. (remm) Correct Asn1Parser.parseLength() to report the actual decoded length instead of a placeholder value when the length is valid but exceeds the available input data, and to use a distinct, accurate message when a length cannot be represented by this implementation due to Java's 32-bit signed int limitation rather than misreporting it as an invalid length. (michaelo) Align the OCSP checking performed by the OpenSSL/Panama based implementation of SSLEngine with the behaviour of the JSSE based implementation so that a certificate that is itself a trust anchor (whether a self-signed root or a certificate trusted directly via the configured trust store) is not subject to OCSP checking. (markt) Add support for the new Elvis (:?) and Null coalescing (??) operators in Jakarta Expression language. (markt) Extend the existing += operator in Jakarta Expression Language to support merging Map and Set and concatenating Lists. (markt) The defaults for compilerSourceVM and compilerTargetVM have been updated to 21 to align with Java 21 being the minimum Java version required for Tomcat 12. (markt) Refactor the performance optimisation for jakarta.servlet.jsp.el.ImportELResolver to use the new marker class, jakarta.el.ELResolver.StandaloneIdentifierMarker. Further performance optimisation by AngeloRubens. (markt) Extend the support for relational operators to include TemporalAccessor, Clock and Date. (markt) Add support for coercion to java.time.Instant and java.util.Date. (markt) Add support for java.util.Optional to the empty operator. (markt) Route JspC servlet context logging through Ant when used as an Ant task. (sainadh777) Correct the handling of the -- argument by jspc. The argument position was advanced past the full stop argument on each iteration while collecting the JSP file arguments, so every second file argument after -- was silently omitted from processing. Option parsing now stops at the first full stop argument wherever it appears. (remm) When removing white-space only template text nodes from the body of a jsp:attribute action while parsing a JSP document, the node that was shifted into the vacated position is now re-examined. Previously it was skipped, which, for bodies containing adjacent template text nodes such as those produced by CDATA sections, could leave a white-space only text node in the body or prevent the final text node from being trimmed when trim was true. (remm) Correct the assignability check GraalBeanELResolver uses when selecting a setter for an EL value. The check was inverted, so a setter whose parameter type was a super-type of the value type, for example a setter taking Object or an interface, was rejected and EL writes to such properties could be silently dropped when running in a GraalVM native image. (remm) The tag plugins for c:when and c:otherwise now fall back to the standard tag handlers when the direct parent tag is not a plugin enabled c:choose. Previously, they generated unbalanced Java code for such misplaced tags, for example a c:when nested directly in a c:forEach, which failed the translation of the entire page instead of reporting the illegal nesting at runtime as the reference implementation does. (remm) The tag plugins for c:import and c:param now share the working URL of the import tag through the plugin context rather than the page scope attribute url_without_param. The import plugin set that attribute while generating the tag body and removed it afterwards, clobbering an application attribute of the same name, and the fixed name made the exchange prone to interference between nested URL tags. This matches the reference implementation, which keeps the parameters of each tag to itself and never touches page scope attributes. (remm) The tag plugin for c:out now uses its body as the fallback for a null value like the standard tag handler does: the body content is captured, trimmed, then written with escaping according to the escapeXml attribute, and the capture is unwound if the body fails. The plugin previously wrote the body inline, including its surrounding whitespace, and did not escape the body content. (remm) The tag plugin for c:set now handles a deferred value expression (#{...}) with a var attribute like the standard tag handler does. Such a value is passed to the tag as a value expression object, and it is now stored as a mapping in the variable mapper of the EL context, where it evaluates lazily, rather than being stored as an attribute holding the raw expression object. As in the standard handler, a non-page scope is rejected for a deferred value, and mappings that would shadow a plain attribute are removed. (remm) The tag plugin for c:set now falls back to the standard tag handler when the tag has a value but neither a var nor a target attribute, so that the invalid use fails as it does with the handler instead of being silently ignored. (remm) The tag plugins for c:url and c:redirect now strip a trailing slash from a context path before joining it with the URL, as the standard tag handlers do, so that a context path ending in a slash no longer produces a resolved path with a doubled slash. Previously only the root context was handled. (remm) The tag plugins for c:url, c:redirect and c:param now share the working URL of the URL tag through the plugin context rather than the page scope attribute url_without_param. That fixed name overwrote an application attribute of the same name while the tag body was processed and removed it afterwards, and it let a nested URL tag destroy the outer tag's URL, which then silently rendered as null. This matches the reference implementation, which keeps the parameters of each tag to itself and never touches page scope attributes. (remm) When the cluster receiver automatically binds to a port other than the configured port, retain the configured port, securePort and udpPort values and expose the bound ports via the new read-only boundPort, boundSecurePort and boundUdpPort properties so that the configured values are not lost when the configuration is stored. (markt) Update Tomcat's WebSocket support to version 2.3 of the Jakarta WebSocket API. (markt) Implement the new HandshakeRequest method, getUserX509CertificateChain() that provides the client certificate chain, if present, during the WebSocket handshake. (markt) Implement the clarification in WebSocket 2.3 that the method ClientEndpointConfig.Configurator.afterResponse() must be called after every WebSocket handshake regardless of whether the handshake is successful or not. (markt) Implement the new HandshakeRequest methods that expose the client's preferred local and the local and remote host name, address and port information. (markt) 69920: When attempting to write a message via a WebSocket session that has been closed, throw an IOException rather than an IllegalStateExcpetion for consistency with Writer and OutputStream. (markt) Make the WebSocket client secure channel wrapper, AsyncChannelWrapperSecure, honor the timeout specified for write operations so a stalled peer cannot block the write thread indefinitely. (remm) Correct the calculation of the digest response value by the WebSocket client when the server uses qop="auth-int". The hash of the (empty) entity body was omitted, resulting in an incorrect response that the server always rejected. (remm) Encode the credentials used for basic authentication by the WebSocket client with UTF-8 by default rather than ISO-8859-1, and reject challenges that specify a charset other than UTF-8, the only value RFC 7617 allows. (remm) Add Manager 2.0 webapp with a modern reactive design. Provided as a module in the modules/manager2 folder in the source package. (remm) Manager: Drop session handling dedicated to extracting the locale from Tapestry attributes, used for locale session sorting. (remm) Host Manager: Host names are now always converted to lower case before use. (markt) Documentation: Expand the documentation of the maxHttpRequestHeaderSize attribute for the HTTP connector. (markt) When the MessageDispatchInterceptor is configured with useDeepClone="false", asynchronously sent messages are now detached from the caller's buffer with a shallow clone before being queued. Previously, the buffer could be returned to the send buffer pool and reused by a concurrent send while the queued message still referenced it, corrupting the transmitted data. (remm) Fix the queue size accounting of the MessageDispatchInterceptor. The message length recorded when a message is queued is now also the length used to release the accounting when the send completes. Previously, when a downstream interceptor like EncryptInterceptor or FragmentationInterceptor replaced or extended the message payload while the message was sent, the recorded queue size drifted towards negative values and the maxQueueSize limit eventually stopped being enforced. (remm) The NonBlockingCoordinator now uses a separate, configurable mergeAliveTimeout with a default of one second for the TCP liveness checks that run while merging an arriving coordination message, instead of the 15 second coordination message wait timeout. Members that do not respond within this timeout are excluded from the merged view and the exclusion is now logged. (remm) The TcpFailureDetector now performs its TCP liveness checks outside the membership monitor, and only applies the result after re-acquiring the monitor and re-checking that the membership state has not changed in the meantime. Previously, the network I/O, up to the configured connection timeout for each member, was performed while holding the monitor, which blocked every other membership operation and update for seconds during a network outage. Member events forwarded by the interceptor are also no longer sent while holding the monitor, removing a potential deadlock with membership listeners that call back into the interceptor. (remm) The TwoPhaseCommitInterceptor now forwards the interceptor payload, and with it the ErrorHandler supplied by the application, with the original message instead of with its internal confirmation message. When the MessageDispatchInterceptor performed the actual send, completion and error callbacks were previously reported under the confirmation message's random id, which the application cannot correlate with the id returned by the send, and failures of the original message were never reported at all. (remm) The TwoPhaseCommitInterceptor now remembers a confirmation message that arrives before the original message it confirms, and releases the original as soon as it arrives. Previously, the confirmation was consumed as an error and the original message was silently dropped when it arrived and no further confirmation ever followed, so a single moment of network reordering cost one lost cluster message. (remm) The AbstractReplicatedMap now holds the map members lock and the state lock only briefly. The entry relocation triggered by the ping expiry runs outside the map members lock, the backup selection for a newly added member outside the state lock, and the (de)serialization of the map content for a member joining or transferring its state likewise outside the state lock. Previously, a slow send to a dead member or the serialization of a large map blocked every session operation and the state transfer of joining members for the duration of that work. (remm) The udpRxBufSize and udpTxBufSize configured on the cluster channel Sender now take effect for messages sent using UDP. These two properties were missing from the properties transferred from the configured sender to the pooled senders and on to the per-member senders those create, so the datagram socket was always configured with the default buffer sizes and the configured values were silently ignored. (remm) The start of the cluster receiver now fails when the configured bind address cannot be resolved. Previously, the resolution failure was only logged and the receiver bound to the wildcard address, silently exposing the cluster listener on all interfaces instead of the configured address, while the unresolvable host was advertised to the other cluster members. (remm) 68436: Reduce the log level from warning to debug for the message logged when driverClassName is not set, as relying on DriverManager to locate the driver is a valid configuration. Pull request 1084 provided by Raphael Vullriede. (markt) 70269: Correct a regression in the change that reset the properties of statements cached by the StatementCache interceptor that meant no statements were cached when using JDBC drivers, such as H2 and MariaDB Connector/J, that always report statements as not poolable. Pull request 1083 provided by Raphael Vullriede. (markt) Update Maven Resolver Ant Tasks to 1.6.1. (rjung) Add test profile system for selective test execution. Profiles can be specified via -Dtest.profile=<name> to run specific test subsets without using patterns directly. Profile patterns are defined in test-profiles.properties. (csutherl) Update Derby to 10.17.1.0. (markt) Add warning when OpenSSL binary is not found. (csutherl) Add check for Tomcat Native library, and log warning when it's not found to make it easier to see when it's not used by the suite. (csutherl) Update Checkstyle to 14.1.0. (markt) Add directory prefix to embedded ZIP packaging. (schultz) Generate a JaCoCo XML coverage report (output/coverage/jacoco.xml) alongside the existing HTML report when the build is run with code coverage enabled. (dsoumis) 69902: Change the ZIP distribution to store the same file and directory permissions as the tar.gz distribution so that the scripts in bin are executable when the archive is extracted on a Unix platform.
